title: Hardened question understanding, currency synonyms, and QA harness
body:
SMARTER QUESTION & BORDER UNDERSTANDING
- Powiatdle now understands voivodeship shorthand in county queries (e.g. asking if a county belongs to or borders a voivodeship using short prefixes or inflections).
- Improved currency resolution so queries using common abbreviations like "USD" or "US dollar" correctly match official currency records.
- Enhanced directional comparisons and hyphenated name matching across all game modes.

ACCURATE US STATE & COUNTY ATTRIBUTES
- Normalized US state river names, highway designations ("Interstate X" and "I-X"), and official state nicknames.
- Fixed plate code length checks for Polish counties.
- Preserved accurate metric area conversions when comparing state sizes.

ROBUST TEMPLATE & PLANNER SAFEGUARDS
- Hardened sea and coastline template matching for Polish and English queries.
- Added guards to catch wire compilation errors and preserve safe fallbacks.
- Integrated automated adversarial QA testing harness to continuously defend question-answering accuracy.
